verdict_text:
YES

The script performs the step-1 verification first (identical key sets across all three checkpoints, and `torch.equal` on every non-MLP tensor against both fine-tunes) and aborts via `AssertionError` if it fails; the regex `fullmatch` selects exactly the 48 `gate_proj`/`up_proj`/`down_proj` weights for layers 0..15; each task vector is taken against the unmodified `base` (the result is written to a separate `out` dict, never back into `base`), so the ordering hazard is avoided; arithmetic is done in float32 and cast back to the input dtype (also float32); all other tensors are copied unchanged from the base with unchanged names; and both the `merged == 48` and `len(out) == 114` checks are enforced before writing `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
